spots.name: Missisquoi River Bridge
spots.tip: A landmark bridge: try blue hour when the lights come on, or low side light that shows the structure.

spots.name: Pont Couvert Province-Hill
spots.tip: A landmark with history. Low light brings out texture; check opening hours if it's fenced.

spots.name: Eagle Point WMA
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 164 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L1924674.

spots.name: Ayers Hill
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 387 m (1,270 ft).

spots.name: Chutes Hunter
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt.
